top_issues.issue: Primary (accent) buttons carry the neutral control stroke around the accent fill, so their edge reads muddy; the calendar header Join pill has no stroke, so primaries are inconsistent.
top_issues.evidence: signin x=430,y=438: #ffffff | #8a8d95 | #a9530f…; dark: #25262b | #6e7179 | #e88c3e. calendar Join x=1199: #ffffff | #ae5c1b | #a9530f (no grey stroke).
top_issues.fix: For filled buttons draw the 1pt stroke in the fill colour or a darker shade: light #8f4509 on #a9530f, dark #d47a2c on #e88c3e. Keep #8a8d95/#6e7179 only for secondary outlines.

top_issues.issue: Narrow (760pt) layouts keep a 232pt side pane, truncating names and wrapping posts at about 380pt. Calls silently drops the video button and the hover toolbar collides with header rows.
top_issues.evidence: 'Katherine Jo…', 'Grace Hop…', 'Margaret Hamil…' in chats-narrow; 'Katherine Johns…' in calls-narrow; channel-narrow toolbar at y≈56–90 overlaps 'Ada Lovelace 06:27'.
top_issues.fix: Below 900pt shrink the list to 208pt and use compact dates ('Yest.', '14 Nov', 11pt), or collapse the list to avatars (56pt). Keep both call buttons and drop the name to 1 line instead. Place the hover toolbar at y = message top - 16pt, clamped to at least 8pt below the header.

top_issues.issue: At 1920x1080 the conversation is top-anchored, leaving a large dead gap above the composer; chat apps bottom-anchor short histories.
top_issues.evidence: Last message baseline y≈835, composer top y≈997: about 160pt empty. The column is centred at 920pt wide with about 300pt blank either side.
top_issues.fix: Bottom-align the message stack when it is shorter than the viewport (fill the top with spacing), so the latest message sits 16pt above the composer.

top_issues.issue: The settings scroll area cuts a row mid-glyph at the bottom edge, and the background-refresh help paragraph is attached to the tray option instead of notifications.
top_issues.evidence: Row 'Move Wren beside the call window during calls' clipped at y≈713–720 of a 742pt dialog. The help text at y 430–477 sits directly under 'Keep running in the tray…'.
top_issues.fix: Give the scroll area 16pt bottom padding plus a 24pt fade (#ffffff/#25262b to transparent). Move the help paragraph under 'Desktop notifications…', indented 26pt with 4pt top spacing, 12pt.

top_issues.issue: Meeting detail is thin and oddly placed: a fixed 640pt left-aligned card, redundant Location/Online rows, no attendees, and header buttons in a different shape and size from the app's buttons.
top_issues.evidence: Card x 388–1028 on a 916pt pane (250pt empty right). Copy link and Join are 24pt tall fully rounded pills; other buttons are 32pt with 6pt radius.
top_issues.fix: Use the standard 32pt/6pt-radius buttons in the header. Merge Location+Online into one 'Where' row; add Attendees (avatars 20pt, max 8 + '+n') and the body preview. Let the card fill the column up to 760pt.

top_issues.issue: The sign-in stack is top-anchored and the card height changes per step, so the footer and demo button jump between steps and short steps leave a large empty bottom.
top_issues.evidence: Footer y: signin 630, browser 553, device-code 628, finishing 477, failed 596. Logo always at y≈124.
top_issues.fix: Vertically centre logo+card+footer as one group in the window, or give the card a 236pt min-height so the footer is stable. Pin the disclaimer 24pt above the window bottom.

top_issues.issue: Pasted-image thumbnails centre-crop extreme aspect ratios into unrecognisable fragments; remove buttons overlap image content; dark thumbnails have no visible edge.
top_issues.evidence: 3072×256 tile shows 2 clipped birds; 256×3072 shows partial shapes. Thumbnail border #303137 on #25262b is 1.16:1.
top_issues.fix: Letterbox (fit) images inside a 144×96pt tile on #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 with a 1pt #c4c5c9 / #494b51 border. Inset the × 4pt from the tile corner on a 20pt circle with a 2pt ring in the card colour. Caption: file name (12pt) instead of pixel dimensions.

top_issues.issue: The Join button and meeting-link input differ in height, and 'How calls work' uses an off-scale larger body size.
top_issues.evidence: Input y 125–153 (28pt), button y 125–157 (32pt). Body copy ≈15pt with 17pt leading vs 14pt body elsewhere.
top_issues.fix: Make inputs and buttons both 32pt tall (or both 28pt) and vertically centre them in the row. Set the explainer to 14pt/20pt #4a4d55 / #b4b6bf.

top_issues.issue: The side pane and main pane are separated only by a near-identical tint with no divider.
top_issues.fix: Add a 1pt divider at the pane edge: #dfdfe3 (light) / #303137 (dark), matching the header bottom border.

top_issues.issue: The shortcuts modal isn't vertically centred and nearly touches the window bottom; section spacing is uneven.
top_issues.evidence: Modal y 90–787 in an 800pt window (13pt bottom margin). NAVIGATION→row gap 28pt, MESSAGES/APP→row gap 22pt.
top_issues.fix: Centre the modal (equal 24pt min margins) and cap height at window − 48pt with internal scroll. Use 8pt header-to-row and 16pt section-to-section spacing, or split into two columns (Navigation+App | Messages) at widths of 1100pt and above.

top_issues.issue: The results list runs into the key-hint footer with no separation, and kbd chips are nearly invisible as shapes.
top_issues.evidence: Last row ends y≈588, footer chips start y≈604, no divider. Kbd chip outline 1.33:1 (light) and 1.16:1 (dark).
top_issues.fix: Add a 1pt #dfdfe3 / #303137 divider with 8pt padding above the footer. Give kbd chips a #c4c5c9 / #494b51 1pt border plus a 1pt bottom shadow.

top_issues.issue: While loading and when there are no chats, the filter field disappears (layout shift) and the empty list column is completely blank.
top_issues.evidence: Loading/empty: no filter at y 58–86, skeleton starts at y 68. Empty: list column x 64–364 has no content. Empty-state title at y=370 vs 394 on other empty states.
top_issues.fix: Keep the filter field (disabled while loading). In the empty list show 13pt grey 'No chats yet' 24pt below the filter. Align all empty states to the same vertical centre.

top_issues.issue: A long draft grows the composer to about 200pt with no scrollbar or overflow cue and hides most of the conversation.
top_issues.evidence: Composer y 553–761 showing lines 111–119 of 119, with no thumb visible.
top_issues.fix: Cap the composer at 8 lines (about 160pt), show a 4pt scrollbar thumb (#c4c5c9 / #494b51) while overflowing, and add a 12pt top fade.

top_issues.issue: The mention popup overlaps and slices through the last message's text line.
top_issues.evidence: Popup y 614–664 covers the 'The throttling review…' line at y≈606–620, so glyph tops are visible above it.
top_issues.fix: Anchor the popup 8pt above the composer and give it a 1pt #dfdfe3 / #303137 border plus a shadow. Clip the message underneath cleanly or scroll the history up by the popup height.

top_issues.issue: The Retry button outline falls below 3:1 on the failure tint, and the failed message offers no discard option.
top_issues.fix: On tinted rows use border #6b6e76 (≥4:1 on #fbeeee). Add a 'Discard' text button (12pt) after Retry.

top_issues.issue: The image preview is a modal rather than full-window, with mostly empty grey stage and no actions beyond Fit/100%.
top_issues.evidence: Modal x 159–1120, y 24–770; the image occupies y 402–469 only. The light scrim leaves the chat behind readable.
top_issues.fix: Make the preview fill the window with a #000000 at 80% scrim (both themes). Show sender, time and file name top-left (13pt), and Save/Copy/Open buttons top-right next to close.

top_issues.issue: Dialog footers are inconsistent: new-chat puts the primary on the left beside helper text with no Cancel, status-message right-aligns Cancel/Save, and join-on-phone has a lone left button.
top_issues.evidence: new-chat 'Chat with Grace Hopper' at x 400–571; status-message Cancel/Save at x 704–840.
top_issues.fix: Use one footer pattern: helper text left (12pt), actions right-aligned with Cancel before the primary, 8pt gap, 20pt from the dialog edge.
